Then
\[
\left(x^2-\frac{2}{x}\right)^5.
\]

The general term is
\[
\binom{5}{k}(x^2)^{5-k}\left(-\frac{2}{x}\right)^k
=\binom{5}{k}(-2)^k x^{10-3k}.
\]

For \(x^4\):
\[
10-3k=4 \implies k=2.
\]

Thus the coefficient is
\[
\binom{5}{2}(-2)^2=10\cdot4=40.
\]
